details.title: Kinematic-Bifurcation Metamorphic Wheel-Leg (KBMWL)
details.principle: Screw-theory constraint matrix bifurcation at singular configurations
details.math: J_c(q) \cdot \dot{q} = 0 \implies \det(J_c(q^*)) = 0; \text{Branch switch from } \mathrm{SO}(2) \text{ rolling to } \mathrm{SE}(2) \text{ pantograph walking}
details.problem_solved: Climbs 3x wheel diameter obstacles without secondary actuators or clutches
details.phd_novelty: First passive deterministic 1-DOF kinematic bifurcation wheel with closed-form Lyapunov stability
details.validation: Analytical twist-wrench synthesis + PrePoMax contact FEA + high-speed camera dyno
